description: This file contains a test class 'NbapiScanResult' that extends 'PrplMeshBaseTest'. It is designed to perform network scans and validate neighboring BSSs via NBAPI, including processing of TLV data for channel scans and neighbor information in a WiFi network environment. It interacts with network controllers, agents, and sniffer tools, and defines methods for checking neighbor data consistency and scan results.

classes.name: NbapiScanResult
classes.description: A test class for performing NBAPI-based scan result validation in a WiFi network testing framework. It includes methods for verifying neighbors, operating classes, and parsing TLV data from channel scan reports.

methods.name: check_neighbors(self, neighbor_paths, neighbors_num, pos, ch_scan_tlv: sniffer.TlvStruct)
methods.description: Validates neighbor BSS entries against TLV data, ensuring BSSID, SSID, channel bandwidth, and utilization match expected values.

methods.name: check_op_class(self, ch_scan_tlv: sniffer.TlvStruct, nbapi_channel_paths: str)
methods.description: Validates an operator class's scan results, analyzing TLV content for channel, utilization, noise, and neighbor entries.

methods.name: runTest(self)
methods.description: Main test execution that initiates network scans, captures reports, and verifies that scan results contain expected neighbor and channel data.

ctags.name: check_neighbors
ctags.pattern: /^    def check_neighbors(self, neighbor_paths, neighbors_num, pos, ch_scan_tlv: sniffer.TlvStruct/

ctags.name: check_op_class
ctags.pattern: /^    def check_op_class(self, ch_scan_tlv: sniffer.TlvStruct, nbapi_channel_paths: str):$/
